feynman_certification.listener_verdict: Dude, this hook is sick. 'Language models waste billions of parameters memorizing raw encyclopedia facts instead of just looking them up' immediately got me to stop scrolling. You explained the bottleneck with index rebuilds and GPU stalls cleanly without using baby-talk metaphors. Beat 4 got a bit dense with 'masked language signals to backpropagate directly through latent document retrievals'—my brain had to buffer for a second there—but the background worker explanation in the previous sentence kept me on track.
